prompts.crouch_light: Use case: identity-preserve. Game asset SOURCE sheet: exactly NINE COMPLETE Goku pixel-art poses in3columns x3rows, genuine transparent alpha. Input is strict approved design/style: same recognizable face, black spiky hair volume, athletic anatomy, orange gi, navy shirt/sash/wristbands, blue boots with red trim/gold bands. Native130px anime/MUGEN fighting-game pixel art enlarged nearest-neighbor, clean stepped dark contours, limited colors/angular shading; no smooth illustration, antialiasing, blur, gradients or3D. All faceRIGHT, torso3/4, same head/limb/boot size and anatomical scale in every cel. FIRST CELL canonical neutral standing guard for calibration. Other poses change height only by joint flexion/foreshortening. No weapon, effects, shadows, floor, background, text or labels. Martial energy, stable support foot, real shoulder/hip rotation and clear preparation/impact/recovery. Attack CROUCHING LOW SHORT PUNCH. Cells8-9 crouch settling. Feet stay supported and low body built through actual knee flexion, NOT shortened/squeezed legs. Same head size and limb lengths as standing calibration. No stand-up strike, no stretching, no extra limbs. Waist/sash and bent trousers remain coherent.
